briefing.ja: リバーサイド・カフェで、客のノートPCが14時から14時30分の間に持ち去られた。店にいた6人のうち1人が犯人であり、その人の証言カードには嘘が1枚だけ混ざっている。全員の証言を突き合わせて、誰の話が成り立たないかを見つける。
briefing.en: A laptop was taken at Riverside Cafe between 14:00 and 14:30. One of the six people in the cafe is the thief, and one card in that person's hand is a lie.

text.2: Nobody was behind the counter from 14:12.
text.3: I remember the counter was left empty from about twelve past two.
text.4: Now that you mention it, there was nobody at the counter from a little after ten past.
text.5: I would not swear to the exact minute, but I am fairly sure nobody was behind the counter from around twelve past two.

facts.hintJa: counter = カウンター / behind = 〜の後ろに / empty = 誰もいない

text.2: The back door was locked until 14:20.
text.3: The back door stayed locked until twenty past two.
text.4: If anyone had tried the back way out before twenty past, they would have found it locked.
text.5: I cannot be completely certain, but I believe the back door stayed locked until at least twenty minutes past two.

facts.hintJa: back door = 裏口 / locked = 鍵がかかっている / stay = 〜のままである

text.1: Window seat. I saw the room. Until 14:18.
text.2: From the window seat I could see the room until 14:18.
text.3: I sat at the window seat and could see the whole room until about eighteen past.
text.4: From where I sat, I could take in most of the room, at least until just before twenty past.
text.5: I was not really paying attention, but from the window seat I could see most of the room until about eighteen minutes past two.

facts.hintJa: window seat = 窓際の席 / whole = 全体の / take in = 見渡す

text.1: The stairs. A chain across. Until 14:20.
text.2: A chain was across the stairs until 14:20.
text.3: There was a chain across the stairs until twenty past two.
text.4: Anyone heading upstairs before twenty past would have found a chain across the steps.
text.5: I could not tell you who unhooked it in the end, but the chain stayed across the stairs until about twenty past two.

facts.hintJa: chain = 鎖 / across = 横切って / unhook = 外す

text.2: The laptop was still on the table at 14:10.
text.3: I am sure the laptop was still on that table at ten past two.
text.4: The laptop was certainly still sitting there when I looked over at ten past.
text.5: I could be wrong about the exact minute, but the laptop was still on the table at around ten past two.

facts.hintJa: laptop = ノートパソコン / still = まだ / table = テーブル

text.1: The owner. Left his seat. At 14:12.
text.2: The owner left his seat at 14:12.
text.3: The man who owned it left his seat at about twelve past two.
text.4: The owner stepped away from his seat a couple of minutes after ten past.
text.5: I am not completely sure of the time, but the owner walked away from his seat at roughly twelve minutes past two.

facts.hintJa: owner = 持ち主 / leave = 離れる / step away = その場を離れる

text.2: My trolley blocked the front door from 14:13 to 14:17.
text.3: I had my trolley parked in the front doorway from thirteen past to seventeen past.
text.4: Between thirteen past and seventeen past, there was no way round my trolley in that doorway.
text.5: I did not time it exactly, but my trolley was standing in the front doorway from about thirteen past until seventeen past two.

facts.hintJa: trolley = 台車 / block = ふさぐ / doorway = 出入口

text.1: Van doors open. Facing the entrance. Until 14:25.
text.2: My van doors were open, facing the entrance, until 14:25.
text.3: My van sat right in front of the entrance with both doors open until twenty-five past.
text.4: Anyone leaving by the entrance before twenty-five past would have run straight into those open doors.
text.5: I cannot say to the minute when I shut them, but the van stood facing the entrance with its doors open until about twenty-five past two.

facts.hintJa: van = 配送車 / entrance = 入口 / facing = 〜に面して

text.1: Office door. I watched it. Until 14:20.
text.2: I had the office door in sight until 14:20.
text.3: I kept the office door in view until twenty past two.
text.4: As far as I know, that office door did not leave my sight before twenty past.
text.5: I would hesitate to call it constant attention, but the office door was within my sight until about twenty minutes past two.

facts.hintJa: office = 事務室 / in sight = 見えるところに / keep = 〜し続ける

text.2: The till was not opened between 14:05 and 14:25.
text.3: Nobody opened the till between five past and twenty-five past two.
text.4: Had the till been opened between five past and twenty-five past, the printout would show it.
text.5: I do not check it that often, but the printout shows the till was never opened between five past and twenty-five past two.

facts.hintJa: till = レジ / printout = 記録の紙 / show = 示す

text.1: Kitchen floor. Wet. No footprints. Until 14:20.
text.2: The kitchen floor was wet and had no footprints until 14:20.
text.3: I mopped the kitchen floor after the lunch rush, and it stayed wet until twenty past.
text.4: Anyone who walked in there before twenty past would have left prints across my wet floor.
text.5: It dries slowly with the door shut, so the kitchen floor was still wet and unmarked until about twenty past two.

facts.hintJa: mop = 床を拭く / wet = 濡れている / footprint = 足跡

text.2: The store cupboard was locked between 14:10 and 14:20.
text.3: I locked the store cupboard at ten past and kept the key.
text.4: From ten past to twenty past that key was in my pocket, so nobody was getting in.
text.5: I always lock it after the lunch rush, and the key stayed in my pocket from ten past until twenty past two.

facts.hintJa: store cupboard = 備品庫 / lock = 鍵をかける / key = 鍵

text.1: Me. In the store cupboard. At 14:15.
text.2: I was in the store cupboard at 14:15.
text.3: I went to fetch paper cups from the store cupboard at a quarter past.
text.4: I had gone through to the store cupboard by then, so I saw nothing of the room.
text.5: I could not tell you the exact minute, but I had gone to fetch paper cups from the store cupboard by about a quarter past two.

lie.hintJa: store cupboard = 備品庫 / fetch = 取りに行く / paper cup = 紙コップ

contradictions.meaningJa: Aoiは14:15に備品庫にいたと言うが、Yukiは14:10に備品庫へ鍵をかけ、その鍵を自分のポケットに入れていたと言っている。Mikaの14:10の証言で盗まれた時間帯が絞られ、Renの視界とTaroの台車とKenの視線で、その間にフロアを離れられた者がいないことが分かる。

text.2: I went out the front door at 14:13.
text.3: I slipped out the front door at about thirteen past and stayed out there.
text.4: I was already outside getting some air by then, so I saw none of it.
text.5: I cannot give you the exact minute, but I had already gone out through the front door by about thirteen minutes past two.

lie.hintJa: go out = 外へ出る / front door = 正面ドア / air = 外の空気

contradictions.meaningJa: Renは14:13に正面ドアから外へ出たと言うが、Taroの台車が14:13から14:17まで正面の出入口を塞いでいた。Aoiのカウンターの証言、Mikaの14:10の証言、Kenの事務室の扉の証言、Yukiの厨房の床が濡れたままだったという証言で、その時間帯に他の出口も使えなかったことが分かる。

text.3: I went up the stairs at about a quarter past two.
text.4: I had gone up to the other floor by then, so I was not at my table.
text.5: It may not have been exactly then, but I had gone up the stairs by around a quarter past two.

lie.hintJa: upstairs = 上の階 / go up = 上がる / floor = 階

contradictions.meaningJa: Mikaは14:15に上の階にいたと言うが、Renは14:20まで階段に鎖が張られていたと言っている。Yukiの厨房の床、Taroの台車、Kenの事務室の扉、Aoiのカウンターの証言で、その時間帯にフロアから抜けられなかったことが分かる。

text.2: I was in the office at 14:15.
text.3: I was in the office waiting for a signature on my delivery sheet at a quarter past.
text.4: I was through in the office with the paperwork, so I was nowhere near the tables.
text.5: I would have to check the sheet, but I believe I was in the office getting it signed at around a quarter past two.

lie.hintJa: office = 事務室 / delivery sheet = 配達伝票 / sign = 署名する

contradictions.meaningJa: Taroは14:15に事務室にいたと言うが、Kenは14:20まで事務室の扉を見ており、誰も入っていない。Mikaが14:12に持ち主が席を離れたと言い、Aoiのカウンターの証言、Renの視界、Yukiの厨房の床の証言で、その直後のフロアの様子が分かる。

text.2: I went out the back door at 14:15.
text.3: I took the rubbish out the back at about a quarter past two.
text.4: I had stepped out the back with the rubbish, so I was not in the room at all.
text.5: I do that every afternoon, and I am fairly sure I was out the back with the rubbish at around a quarter past two.

lie.hintJa: back door = 裏口 / rubbish = ごみ / take out = 外へ出す

contradictions.meaningJa: Kenは14:15に裏口から外へ出たと言うが、Aoiは裏口が14:20まで施錠されていたと言っている。Taroの配送車が入口に面していたこと、Renの視界、Mikaの14:10の証言、Yukiの厨房の床に足跡がなかったという証言で、その時間帯に店を出た者がいないことが分かる。

text.2: I was at the counter at 14:15.
text.3: I was serving at the counter at about a quarter past two.
text.4: I had come out to cover the counter by then, so I was not in the kitchen.
text.5: It is not what I usually do, but I had come out to cover the counter at around a quarter past two.

lie.hintJa: counter = カウンター / serve = 接客する / cover = 代わりに担当する

contradictions.meaningJa: Yukiは14:15にカウンターにいたと言うが、Aoiは14:12以降カウンターに誰も立っていなかったと言っている。Kenのレジの記録、Mikaの14:10の証言、Renの視界、Taroの台車で、その時間帯に接客が行われていなかったことが分かる。

timelineEn: 14:05 The owner sat down with the laptop on the table.
14:10 The laptop was still on the table.
14:12 The owner left his seat and the counter was empty.
14:15 The laptop was taken from the table.
14:20 The owner came back and the laptop was gone.

keyExpressions.en: I was about to leave when...
keyExpressions.ja: ちょうど出ようとしていたら…

keyExpressions.en: I would not swear to it, but...
Are you sure about the time?
